_README: R1 planning inputs. Every quantity carries a 'kind': measured | bound | assumed | ceiling. R0's inputs are kept unmodified at planning_inputs_R0.json. Nothing here is a fit, a schedule or a certificate.
baseline_note: Identical to the head R0 checked; no drift between R0's snapshot and this review.

device.confirm_before_signoff: exact part/package and usable resources must come from the tool/device report, not from this file

v1_measured.caveat: Analysis and Synthesis ESTIMATES. This design has never placed: no ALM figure and no Fmax may be quoted from it.

state_lever._what: R0's central bet: bulk state into banked memory.

measured_conversion._note: The single FLOPARRAY conversion on record, on a favourable case: wide, shallow, single-ported.

bound_if_every_flop_array_converted._note: Physically unreachable; pipeline and control flops and anything needing more than two concurrent ports cannot move.

state_lever.limiter: port count, not memory capacity: banking 60% of this state costs ~7 M10K of 553

concentration._what: How many nodes must be touched to reach a share of total ALUTs. Decides whether V2 can be surgical.
concentration.conclusion: Long tail. No surgical rewrite exists; a V2 is a ~400-node migration under a uniform rule.

mass_classification._caveat: dsp and mem are SUBTREE values, so classes are not a strict partition and must not be summed with the state_lever figures.
mass_classification.conclusion: Half the machine carries neither a DSP nor a memory bit - this is the class R0 proposes to replace with scheduled engines.

timing._caveat: Leaf blocks fitted in isolation with few pins. A design's clock is its WORST path, and composition only lowers Fmax.

only_composed_console_placement._note: Roughly a quarter of the present design (284 sources today). The only composed timing datum that exists.

derived_budget._what: R1 replaces R0's chosen 35,000 total with a derived one. It does not balance, and that is the deliverable.

levers.name: storage: flop arrays to banked M10K

derived_budget.residual_must_come_from: occupancy restructuring - replacing private per-feature blocks with scheduled engines. UNMEASURED. Experiments E1 and the Gate-B skeleton exist to produce this number.

rate_lever_available._why: R0's own geometry count needs 4-6 perfect lanes at 100 MHz before omitted work; at 60 MHz four lanes exceed the 800,000-cycle reserve. Area-for-time is already spent on rate-bound paths.

r0_figures_retained_for_comparison._agent_note: R0 never states this ratio. R1 rejects the table as not derived; see design/v2/reviews/R0-agent-review.md D1.

gate_0_missing_input.name: legal joint workload envelope
gate_0_missing_input.evidence: design/V1-RELEASE-DEFINITION.md states guarantees in gameplay terms; no numeric per-frame joint demand vector anywhere in the tree.
gate_0_missing_input.consequence: Until ratified, every allocation in R0 and R1 is arbitrary.

feasibility: UNPROVEN. No V2 fit, schedule, simulation or board result is represented here. A lower bound above a budget rejects a configuration; a lower bound below it certifies nothing.
